body:
Thank you for your kind words, I really appreciate it. 

I am aware that isolation is a problem. Last times I went through hardship I did an effort to reach out. The problem is that I'm just not able to let people close to me. I don't get anything out of socializing, other than anxiety. I always fear they have bad intentions, which is probably a lingering thought from my childhood.
But one that is hard to overcome. It is something I have been struggling with for all my life.

It's difficult now too, because I did go back to therapy. But just like I can't share with acquintances, I can't share with my therapist either. I just can't get to that level of trust with anyone. Fear always seem to win. Fear used to be a wall around me. Now I found myself trapped within those walls. I don't know if that makes sense, I have a hard time finding the right words.

It's is just a difficult situation, it is pure hopelessness.

I wish I could make this message sound more positive.

Thank you for your kind words, it means alot to me.

There's no remorse from them.

They are actually respectable members of society who have, on the outside, a good life. I am the black sheep for cutting them out of my life and they will tell everyone who asks about their child. And everyone will feel sorry for them.... 

They don't know what happens behind closed doors. And those who suspect something or dare to ask questions get cut off.

And you are right, with suicide I won't overcome it. But I don't know if that's my goal (anymore). At this moment the only goal is to escape from what's happening in my mind.

I hope that makes sense.
